messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I opened a small PR to tweak the prod overlay HTTP probe timeouts for the inference-service. Seeing sporadic readiness failures in canary this morning. PR: https://git.redwood/proj/infra/merge_requests/987
Rafael: What do the failures look like? Crashloop? readiness-only? Any logs?
Maya: readiness fails then kube marks not-ready, not a crash. Logs show cold KV cache + long init path — probe hits during startup. Example log: `startup: loading kv cache (took ~2.8s)`
Gina: Can you paste the current probe snippet from the manifest?
Maya: Sure:
```yaml
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 1
  timeoutSeconds: 1
  failureThreshold: 3
```
Rafael: period=1 + timeout=1 is pretty aggressive for this service. If cold start can take ~2.5s, probe should tolerate that. Suggest: `periodSeconds: 5`, `timeoutSeconds: 3`, `failureThreshold: 6`. That gives ~30s window to stabilize during canary.
Ben: Also double-check the TF overlay that wires the secret used for the feature flag — we had a secret path rename last month and a few pods were starting without config which caused readiness flaps. Did the PR include the secret path change?
Maya: Yes, updated k8s secret ref and the overlay TF mapping: `secretsmanager_path = "/prod/inference/http-probe-config"` (see PR diff). I linked the release note about the rename.
Chloe: Any impact to autoscaling or rollouts? Increasing probe windows can delay scale-down detection. Might affect HPA responsiveness.
Rafael: True but for canary we want stability first. We can tweak HPA scaleDown behavior separately. Plan: deploy canary with new probe settings, run 30m smoke, if healthy promote.
infra-bot: CI pipeline: staging canary deploy succeeded — job#2245. Diff shows only probe + secret mapping changes. No image bumps.
Maya: @Rafael can you review the PR when you have a minute? I added a small rollback step in the runbook in case probe tweaks cause other regressions.
Rafael: Will review now. Main ask: include a note in the overlay docs about why timeout increased and mention the secret path rename. Also add a small KMS IAM check in TF plan (ensure role has kms:Decrypt for secret).
Gina: For the TF plan, remind to run `terraform plan -var=env=prod` against the overlay workspace; we had drift last time when someone ran against the global workspace.
Maya: Got it — adding KMS check and a one-liner to the PR description about `terraform workspace select overlays/prod` and the rollout steps.
Ben: 👍 once CI green + Rafael approves, run canary + 30m observation. If anything odd, revert probe values and redeploy.
Maya: Thanks all — scheduling canary in ~20m.
infra-bot: Reminder: please add a post-deploy note in #incidents if you see >3 readiness failures per minute during canary.
